title: Build a chapter outline

stage.name: Outline
stage.description: The chapters are planned, from the first page to the last.

intro: A map of the story before you write it.

options: Planning the order of events or ideas before drafting
questions.why: An outline shows the shape of the book so the writing has a direction.

questions.prompt: Put a classic story shape in order.
questions.why: Most stories, from fairy tales to films, follow some version of this arc.

questions.prompt: An outline can change as you write.
questions.why: Outlines are guides, not cages. Writers adjust them as the story grows.

questions.prompt: What's a healthy way for a couple to talk about milestones?
options: Share hopes and timelines openly and stay flexible
Set strict deadlines for the other person
Follow the timeline other people expect
questions.why: Plans work best when both people help make them and both can adjust them.

talk: What milestones would you like to reach together, and roughly when?
